title: Exterior pairing on supported cohomology classes
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum $A=A_{E,n}$ and algebraically closed field $k$ of [sk-def-purity-conv]. Let $a_X:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be locally finite type, and $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, $j:W\hookrightarrow Y$ closed immersions. Put $T=X\times_kY$, $h:Q=Z\times_kW\hookrightarrow T$. Use the pro-etale supported-Hom model and twists of [def-pur-supported-class-operations], and the right-shift-first tensor comparison $\sigma_{a,b}$ of [def-pur-supported-cup]. For all $a,b,r,s\in\mathbf Z$ and $\alpha:i_*A_Z\to A_X(r)[a]$, $\beta:j_*A_W\to A_Y(s)[b]$, define their supported exterior class as follows. Use the normalized adjunction $C_i\dashv R\Gamma_Z$ of [def-pur-proetale-supported-exterior-product] to transpose $\alpha$ to $A[0]\to R\Gamma_Z(A_X(r)[a])$, including the canonical degree-zero constant-coefficient comparison; use the same construction for $\beta$. Commute shifts past supported sections, tensor these transposes, and precompose with the canonical $A[0]\to A[0]\otimes_A^L A[0]$ carrying $1$ to $1\otimes1$. Apply $\sigma_{a,b}$ and the shifted specified map $\kappa_{A_X(r),A_Y(s)}^{Z,W}$ of [def-pur-proetale-supported-exterior-product]. Apply supported sections to the canonical coefficient map $A_X(r)\boxtimes_A^L A_Y(s)\to A_T(r+s)$ obtained from the exact projection inverse-image comparisons, the degree-zero tensor localization comparison, and the normalized twist pullbacks and multiplication of [def-pur-supported-class-operations]. Commute the output shift back and transpose under $C_h\dashv R\Gamma_Q$. This defines $\alpha\boxtimes\beta:h_*A_Q\to A_T(r+s)[a+b]$, read as a class of $H_Q^{a+b}(T,A(r+s))$ under the normalization of [lem-pur-supported-hom-adjunction-transpose]. This definition uses the specified derived exterior map and introduces no new choice of that map.
